BTS Group Unites Executives and Employees for Blood Donate Drive, Saving Lives-First Activity of 2026

Back 12 February 2026

On 12 February 2026, executives from all companies within BTS Group, led by Mr. Nattachai Pradermchit, Mr. Tawatchai Panichayakorn, and Dr. Nalinrut Masomboon, joined employees in participating in the first blood donation activity of 2026. The event was organized in collaboration with the Thai Red Cross Society at the BTS Skytrain Headquarters.

This initiative was held in support of the “Give Blood Now” campaign, with the objective of ensuring a sufficient blood supply for patient treatment during both normal circumstances and periods of shortage. A total of 117,000 cc of blood was collected and delivered to the National Blood Centre, Thai Red Cross Society. The activity received strong support and cooperation from BTS Group executives and employees, reflecting their shared recognition of the importance of contributing to society through selfless giving.

BTS Group remain committed to continuously undertaking social responsibility initiatives, firmly believing that blood donation is a meaningful act that helps extend opportunities and hope to others, while fostering a strong sense of social responsibility. Through these efforts, the Group aims to help alleviate blood shortages and contribute to the sustainable development of Thai society.
